newsitem.title: USA: Vermont still grappling with property tax reform.
newsitem.headline: Vermont still grappling with property tax reform.

text.p: NEW YORK, June 2 (Reuter) This could be the final week of the 1997 session of the Vermont legislature, but while lawmakers have finished most of the required business for the year, an agreement on tax reform remains elusive.

House and Senate negotiators met several times last week hoping to reconcile differences on how to pay for Vermont schools in the wake of a Supreme Court ruling that says the current method is unconstitutional.

Both chambers have passed measures that would establish a state-wide property tax rate and other taxes to raise money for schools. Legislative leaders are hoping that a final agreement can be reached this week.
